tasks.label: show-villa-svg
tasks.command:
curl -s -b /tmp/kv_r4.txt 'http://localhost:3001/api/v1/tenants/f4c1bdd2-6720-4a0d-9136-cb38423ad439/reports/7eab5b50-a465-4c83-af59-1a57e8765a0b' | python3 -c "
import sys,json
r=json.load(sys.stdin)
d=r.get('data',r)
h=d.get('html_content','')

import re
m=re.search(r'<svg[\s\S]*?</svg>', h, re.I)
if m:
    print(m.group(0))
"
